lines.gurmukhi: ਧਿਗੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਦਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਆਸ ॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: dhig tinhaa daa jeeviaa jinaa vidaanee aas ||21||
lines.translation: Cursed are the lives of those who place their hopes in others. ||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੇ ਮੈ ਹੋਦਾ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤਾ ਆਇੜਿਆਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa je mai hodaa vaariaa mitaa aaiRiaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Fareed, if I had been there when my friend came, I would have made myself a sacrifice to him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇੜਾ ਜਲੈ ਮਜੀਠ ਜਿਉ ਉਪਰਿ ਅੰਗਾਰਾ ॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: heRaa jalai majeeth jiu upar a(n)gaaraa ||22||
lines.translation: Now my flesh is burning red on the hot coals. ||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਲੋੜੈ ਦਾਖ ਬਿਜਉਰੀਆਂ ਕਿਕਰਿ ਬੀਜੈ ਜਟੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa loRai daakh bijaureeaa(n) kikar beejai jat ||
lines.translation: Fareed, the farmer plants acacia trees, and wishes for grapes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੰਢੈ ਉਂਨ ਕਤਾਇਦਾ ਪੈਧਾ ਲੋੜੈ ਪਟੁ ॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: ha(n)dhai u(n)n kataaidaa paidhaa loRai pat ||23||
lines.translation: He is spinning wool, but he wishes to wear silk. ||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਗਲੀਏ ਚਿਕੜੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa galeee chikaR door ghar naal piaare nehu ||
lines.translation: Fareed, the path is muddy, and the house of my Beloved is so far away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲਾ ਤ ਭਿਜੈ ਕੰਬਲੀ ਰਹਾਂ ਤ ਤੁਟੈ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: chalaa ta bhijai ka(n)balee rahaa(n) ta tutai nehu ||24||
lines.translation: If I go out, my blanket will get soaked, but if I remain at home, then my heart will be broken. ||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਿਜਉ ਸਿਜਉ ਕੰਬਲੀ ਅਲਹ ਵਰਸਉ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhijau sijau ka(n)balee alah varasau mehu ||
lines.translation: My blanket is soaked, drenched with the downpour of the Lord's Rain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਜਣਾ ਤੁਟਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: jaai milaa tinaa sajanaa tutau naahee nehu ||25||
lines.translation: I am going out to meet my Friend, so that my heart will not be broken. ||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮੈ ਭੋਲਾਵਾ ਪਗ ਦਾ ਮਤੁ ਮੈਲੀ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa mai bholaavaa pag daa mat mailee hoi jaai ||
lines.translation: Fareed, I was worried that my turban might become dirty.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਲਾ ਰੂਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਸਿਰੁ ਭੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: gahilaa roohu na jaanaee sir bhee mitee khaai ||26||
lines.translation: My thoughtless self did not realize that one day, dust will consume my head as well. ||26||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸਕਰ ਖੰਡੁ ਨਿਵਾਤ ਗੁੜੁ ਮਾਖਿਓੁ ਮਾਂਝਾ ਦੁਧੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa sakar kha(n)d nivaat guR maakhiou maa(n)jhaa dudh ||
lines.translation: Fareed: sugar cane, candy, sugar, molasses, honey and buffalo's milk

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਵਸਤੂ ਮਿਠੀਆਂ ਰਬ ਨ ਪੁਜਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe vasatoo mitheeaa(n) rab na pujan tudh ||27||
lines.translation: - all these things are sweet, but they are not equal to You. ||27||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰੋਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਲਾਵਣੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਭੁਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa rotee meree kaath kee laavan meree bhukh ||
lines.translation: Fareed, my bread is made of wood, and hunger is my appetizer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਖਾਧੀ ਚੋਪੜੀ ਘਣੇ ਸਹਨਿਗੇ ਦੁਖ ॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa khaadhee chopaRee ghane sahanige dukh ||28||
lines.translation: Those who eat buttered bread, will suffer in terrible pain. ||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੁਖੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਖਾਇ ਕੈ ਠੰਢਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: rukhee sukhee khaai kai tha(n)dhaa paanee peeu ||
lines.translation: Eat dry bread, and drink cold water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਚੋਪੜੀ ਨਾ ਤਰਸਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa dekh paraaee chopaRee naa tarasaae jeeu ||29||
lines.translation: Fareed, if you see someone else's buttered bread, do not envy him for it. ||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜੁ ਨ ਸੁਤੀ ਕੰਤ ਸਿਉ ਅੰਗੁ ਮੁੜੇ ਮੁੜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aj na sutee ka(n)t siu a(n)g muRe muR jaai ||
lines.translation: This night, I did not sleep with my Husband Lord, and now my body is suffering in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤੁਮ ਕਿਉ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: jaai puchhahu dohaaganee tum kiu rain vihaai ||30||
lines.translation: Go and ask the deserted bride, how she passes her night. ||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahurai dhoee naa lahai peeeai naahee thaau ||
lines.translation: She finds no place of rest in her father-in-law's home, and no place in her parents' home either.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਵਾਤੜੀ ਨ ਪੁਛਈ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: pir vaataRee na puchhaee dhan sohaagan naau ||31||
lines.translation: Her Husband Lord does not care for her; what sort of a blessed, happy soul-bride is she? ||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਕੰਤ ਕੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahurai peeeai ka(n)t kee ka(n)t aga(n)m athaahu ||
lines.translation: In her father-in-law's home hereafter, and in her parents' home in this world, she belongs to her Husband Lord. Her Husband is Inaccessible and Unfathomable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ ॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak so sohaaganee j bhaavai beparavaah ||32||
lines.translation: O Nanak, she is the happy soul-bride, who is pleasing to her Carefree Lord. ||32||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਤੀ ਧੋਤੀ ਸੰਬਹੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਆਇ ਨਚਿੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naatee dhotee sa(n)bahee sutee aai nachi(n)d ||
lines.translation: Bathing, washing and decorating herself, she comes and sleeps without anxiety.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰਹੀ ਸੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਹਿੰਙੁ ਦੀ ਗਈ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਗੰਧੁ ॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa rahee s beRee hi(n)ng dee gaee kathooree ga(n)dh ||33||
lines.translation: Fareed, she still smells like asafoetida; the fragrance of musk is gone. ||33||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਬਨ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਨਾ ਡਰਾਂ ਜੇ ਸਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: joban jaa(n)de naa daraa(n) je sah preet na jaai ||
lines.translation: I am not afraid of losing my youth, as long as I do not lose the Love of my Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਿਤਂੀ ਜੋਬਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਕਿ ਗਏ ਕੁਮਲਾਇ ॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa kita(n)ee joban preet bin suk gae kumalaai ||34||
lines.translation: Fareed, so many youths, without His Love, have dried up and withered away. ||34||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਚਿੰਤ ਖਟੋਲਾ ਵਾਣੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛਾਵਣ ਲੇਫੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa chi(n)t khatolaa vaan dukh birahi vichhaavan leph ||
lines.translation: Fareed, anxiety is my bed, pain is my mattress, and the pain of separation is my blanket and quilt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਚੇ ਵੇਖੁ ॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: ehu hamaaraa jeevanaa too saahib sache vekh ||35||
lines.translation: Behold, this is my life, O my True Lord and Master. ||35||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਹਾ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਤੂ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: birahaa birahaa aakheeai birahaa too sulataan ||
lines.translation: Many talk of the pain and suffering of separation; O pain, you are the ruler of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਮਸਾਨੁ ॥੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa jit tan birahu na oopajai so tan jaan masaan ||36||
lines.translation: Fareed, that body, within which love of the Lord does not well up - look upon that body as a cremation ground. ||36||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਏ ਵਿਸੁ ਗੰਦਲਾ ਧਰੀਆਂ ਖੰਡੁ ਲਿਵਾੜਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa e vis ga(n)dalaa dhareeaa(n) kha(n)d livaaR ||
lines.translation: Fareed, these are poisonous sprouts coated with sugar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਰਾਹੇਦੇ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਇਕਿ ਰਾਧੀ ਗਏ ਉਜਾੜਿ ॥੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: ik raahede rahi gae ik raadhee gae ujaaR ||37||
lines.translation: Some die planting them, and some are ruined, harvesting and enjoying them. ||37||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਹੰਢਿ ਕੈ ਚਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਸੰਮਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa chaar gavaaiaa ha(n)dh kai chaar gavaaiaa sa(n)m ||
lines.translation: Fareed, the hours of the day are lost wandering around, and the hours of the night are lost in sleep.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖਾ ਰਬੁ ਮੰਗੇਸੀਆ ਤੂ ਆਂਹੋ ਕੇਰ੍ਹੇ ਕੰਮਿ ॥੩੮॥
lines.transliteration: lekhaa rab ma(n)geseeaa too aa(n)ho kerhe ka(n)m ||38||
lines.translation: God will call for your account, and ask you why you came into this world. ||38||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵਾਜੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਕਿਉ ਡਿਠੋ ਘੜੀਆਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa dar daravaajai jaai kai kiu ditho ghaReeaal ||
lines.translation: Fareed, you have gone to the Lord's Door. Have you seen the gong there?

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਨਿਦੋਸਾਂ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਹਮ ਦੋਸਾਂ ਦਾ ਕਿਆ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੩੯॥
lines.transliteration: ehu nidosaa(n) maareeai ham dosaa(n) daa kiaa haal ||39||
lines.translation: This blameless object is being beaten - imagine what is in store for us sinners! ||39||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘੜੀਏ ਘੜੀਏ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਪਹਰੀ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghaReee ghaReee maareeai paharee lahai sajaai ||
lines.translation: Each and every hour, it is beaten; it is punished every day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹੇੜਾ ਘੜੀਆਲ ਜਿਉ ਡੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੪੦॥
lines.transliteration: so heRaa ghaReeaal jiu dukhee rain vihaai ||40||
lines.translation: This beautiful body is like the gong; it passes the night in pain. ||40||
